svg.title: Sanzeed thank-you postcard — back
svg.desc: Postal layout: divider, address lines, stamp box; signature mark and contact on the left. Units: 1 user unit = 1 mm. Layers: paper, artwork, guides (non-printing). Fonts: Fraunces 300, Inter Tight 600, Inter 400 (04_TYPOGRAPHY/Font_Files). Logo paths embedded from 02_LOGO_SYSTEM/SVG.

g.inkscape:label: guides (non-printing)
g.text: TRIM 148 × 105 mm · BLEED 3 mm · SAFE 6 mm
